items.title: What is Agent Bricks?
items.snippet: Agent Bricks is the Databricks agent developer platform, designed to help build and deploy agents that power agentic products and workflows. It supports developers in building agents with any framework or harness and integrating any model. The platform is built for developers who write code.

items.title: Introducing Personal Agent Protocol
items.snippet: Sierra, in collaboration with Meta and industry partners including Genesys, Instinct, Rocket, Shopify, Stripe, and Walmart, announced the Personal Agent Protocol. This open standard defines how personal agents interact with businesses, providing a trusted way for brands to understand who an AI agent represents, its authorization, and intent for secure interactions.

items.title: Agent Lightning v1.0: A 3,500-Line Lightweight Agentic RL Framework for Training Agents with Real Harnesses
items.snippet: Agent Lightning v1.0 is a lightweight (approx. 3,500 lines of code) agentic RL framework for training agents with real harnesses. It introduces an LLM proxy between the agent and the model, allowing observation and recording of model calls during training without modifying existing harness code. The framework also supports native Kubernetes for scalable rollouts and provides a complete coding agent training example.

items.title: CoreWeave Agent Lens | AI Agent Observability
items.snippet: CoreWeave Agent Lens offers intelligent observability for production AI agents, enabling teams to monitor agent behavior, pinpoint failures, trace issues to their root cause, and evaluate fixes. This platform facilitates continuous improvement of agent performance through a connected workflow. Users can create and tune custom LLM judges from failure clusters, incorporating domain expert feedback to refine evaluations.

items.title: Agent skills for AI coding assistants
items.snippet: Databricks has introduced task-specific skills embedded within its app templates for AI coding assistants. These skills are compatible with agents built using frameworks like LangGraph, LangChain, and OpenAI Agents SDK, as well as Databricks App Kits and various chatbot/data app frameworks. The new capabilities facilitate instrumenting, debugging, and evaluating LLM agents with MLflow.

items.title: Embodied AI Hardware for Robot Learning
items.snippet: Choosing embodied AI hardware involves more than just selecting a robot arm; a comprehensive research stack integrates manipulators, end effectors, cameras, compute, controllers, and a teleoperation interface. The core stack for robot learning requires a task-capable robot, an appropriate gripper, synchronized sensing, control and compute, and a human interface for setup or teleoperation. Mobility components should be added only when experiments necessitate environmental movement, emphasizing the importance of integrated and repeatable setups for effective research.

dropped.title: Parallel - Web Infrastructure for AI Agents
dropped.snippet: Parallel gives agents real-time access to fresh and relevant context from the web. Search billions of pages, extract key information, monitor changes, and do complex research with cited outputs you can trust in production. The company is an enterprise SaaS business focused on workflow automation, backed by Sequoia and Index Ventures.

dropped.title: Introducing Mistral Large 4
dropped.snippet: Mistral Large 4 demonstrates exceptional performance across coding, agentic workflows, and multimodal understanding. It achieves performance competitive with the strongest open-source models globally, and significantly outperforms any open-weight model developed in the US or Europe. On critical enterprise workloads, including cybersecurity, finance and law, it is state-of-the-art among open models.

dropped.title: Gemini at Work 2026: Introducing Gemini agent
dropped.snippet: Google Cloud has announced the Gemini agent, a universal agent designed to streamline various work tasks, from knowledge work and answering questions to content creation and coding, all accessible from a single prompt box. This agent plans tasks, utilizes skills and tools, connects to existing systems, and delivers finished work directly within familiar documents, inboxes, and developer environments. It is engineered to operate by delegating objectives rather than requiring step-by-step instructions.
